subject: Request: Executive approval for Riverbend Health bundle + custom integration
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Roy <anika@riverbend.health>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: Enterprise bundle + onboarding for Riverbend Health

Hi Anika —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is our initial proposal for Riverbend's enterprise purchase: 24-month commitment for the Enterprise Bundle (hosted inference + Dedicated reserve) plus a 6-week onboarding program and a scoped custom ETL connector for your patient data pipeline. Highlights: 
- Premium Support included (24/7, 15-minute P1 SLA) for the first year
- Onboarding package: 6 weeks, dedicated solutions engineer, integration testing
- Custom ETL connector: scope outlined in SOW section 3 (data mapping + incremental sync)
- Pricing: see attached RB_Enterprise_Pricing_Sheet.xlsx (line items and seat tiers)

If you'd like, I can walk through the SOW with Marcus and procurement next week.

Attachments: Riverbend_Statement_of_Work_v1.pdf (application/pdf), RB_Enterprise_Pricing_Sheet.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Anika Roy <anika@riverbend.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Delaney <mdelaney@riverbend.health>, procurement@riverbend.health
Date: 2027-05-22T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Enterprise bundle + onboarding for Riverbend Health

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the proposal. A few items we need for internal approval before we can move to contract: 
1) Can you include Premium Support (24/7) for both years? Our clinical apps require continuous coverage.
2) We need the custom ETL connector to include support for our legacy HL7 v2 feed (not currently documented in the SOW). That increases scope by an estimated 40 hours of engineering.
3) Pricing: Procurement is asking if Redwood can provide a 35% discount on list to meet our budget threshold.
4) Data residency in us-east (we require processing/storage in the US).

I can jump on a call if helpful. Procurement needs an updated term sheet by Friday to meet our June 1 review.

Thanks,
Anika
Director of Integrations, Riverbend Health
Anika.Roy@riverbend.health

Date: 2027-05-22T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Proposal: Enterprise bundle + onboarding for Riverbend Health

Vivek —

Forwarding Riverbend's reply. They want Premium Support extended to both years, HL7 v2 added to the ETL scope (~40 engineer hours), and are asking for a 35% discount. Procurement needs the updated term sheet by Friday (2027-05-28) for their internal June 1 review.

My recommendation: we can approve Premium Support for the second year if they commit to a 24-month term and accept a 25% discount. The custom HL7 work can be included as a capped scope (up to 40 hours at no charge) or converted to billable hours after that. This preserves margin but helps close the deal.

They are a mid-sized regional health system; strategic for our healthcare vertical. Happy to hop on a quick sync to run through figures.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments: Riverbend_Statement_of_Work_v1.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-23T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Re: Proposal: Enterprise bundle + onboarding for Riverbend Health — Exec approval request

Team —

Summary: Riverbend asks for (A) Premium Support included both years, (B) HL7 v2 connector added (~40 hours), (C) 35% discount. Marissa proposes 25% discount + include up to 40 hours of HL7 work at no charge, contingent on 24-month term.

Recommendation for executive signoff:
- Approve Premium Support through year 2 (no additional SOW line item) if customer signs 24-month commitment and pays 50% upfront at renewal cadence.
- Approve one-time concession: include up to 40 hours of HL7 work free; any overage billed at our standard services rate.
- Approve discount cap at 25% off list for this deal. Any increase beyond 25% requires CRO signoff.

Impacts & mitigations:
- Margin hit estimated at ~12% with 25% discount and free 40h work; acceptable given vertical strategic value and expected referenceability.
- Legal must confirm data residency language and include us-east region in the SLA appendix. Finance to confirm payment terms (50% upfront).

Ask: Ben/Laura please confirm approval for the above decisions so I can reply to Riverbend and instruct legal/finance to prepare documents.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Commercial — Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Roy <anika@riverbend.health>, Marcus Delaney <mdelaney@riverbend.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, procurement@riverbend.health
Date: 2027-05-25T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Decision: Riverbend Health enterprise bundle — approved with conditions

Anika / Marcus —

Thanks for the clarification and for outlining your needs. Executive decision: Redwood will move forward with the Enterprise Bundle under the following, confirmed conditions: 
1) Term: 24 months (effective date on signature).
2) Pricing: 25% discount off list (final pricing attached).
3) Premium Support: included for both years per the SOW.
4) Custom ETL: we will include up to 40 hours of engineering work to support HL7 v2 legacy feed as part of the onboarding. Any work beyond that will be billed at our standard services rate; scope & acceptance criteria will be captured in a revised SOW.
5) Data residency: Redwood will process and store customer data in us-east for this deployment; this will be added to the SLA appendix.
6) Payment: 50% upfront at signing; remainder net 30.

Next steps: Marissa will send an updated term sheet and SOW (RB_Statement_of_Work_v1 — revised) to procurement and route to DocuSign. Legal and Finance will include the us-east residency language and invoice terms. Please confirm if the above captures everything you need to proceed.

Attachments: signed-term-sheet-draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Commercial — Redwood Inference
